name: Public site
description: Public pages that plugins declare (blog posts, catalogs, landing pages), rendered on the server from their published records

page.title: Site
page.description: The public site shows the pages that plugins publish (blog, shop, catalog).
page.noPages: No plugin publishes pages yet. Install a blog or shop plugin so the site has content.

address.title: Address
address.description: Where the site answers. The app stays at the path set in Settings → General.
address.hostHint: Use it when the site has its own domain, such as www.yourcompany.com, pointed at this server. Empty, the site uses the same address as the app.
address.pathHint: Empty = root. Without its own domain, it must differ from the app path.
address.locked: Only system administrators can change the address.
address.indexing: Let search engines find the site
address.indexingHint: When off, the site stays open to anyone with the link but asks search engines (Google, Bing) not to list it and does not publish the sitemap. Useful while the site is being built.
address.redirectHosts: Other domains that lead to the site (optional)
address.redirectHostsHint: Separate with commas. Whoever opens one of them, such as yourcompany.com without www, is sent to {{host}} on the same path (permanent redirect).
address.dnsPoint: In your domain registrar's panel, point {{hosts}} at this server (an A record with the server IP, or a CNAME to its address).
address.dnsTls: The padlock (HTTPS) certificate is issued by the proxy or load balancer in front of Aphel. Include all these domains in it.
address.dnsResolves: {{host}} points to {{addresses}}. Check that this is the address of this server.
address.dnsMissing: {{host}} does not point anywhere yet. DNS changes can take a few hours.

appearance.title: Scrollbar
appearance.description: How the scrollbar looks on the site pages.
appearance.themeHint: Themes come from plugins. The default theme is simple and follows dark mode.
appearance.taglineHint: Shown below the site name at the top. Up to 160 characters. Name, logo and colors are in Site → Appearance.
appearance.scrollbarHint: Applies to the page and to areas that scroll sideways, such as carousels.

menu.linkUrlHint: A site path, such as /book/intro-call for the booking page, or a full address starting with https://.

redirects.title: Moved addresses
redirects.description: When the address of some content changes (for example a post slug), the old address leads to the new one. Remove a redirect if the old address should answer "page not found" again.
redirects.empty: No address has moved so far.

cache.title: Page updates
cache.description: Pages are kept so they open fast and refresh on their own when the content changes. Use the button if something stays out of date.
cache.purged: Pages will be generated again on the next visit

errors.path: Use only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, in a single segment (e.g. blog).
errors.pathReserved: This path is used by the API. Choose another one.
errors.host: Enter only the domain, such as www.yourcompany.com, without http:// or a path.
errors.pathTaken: The app already uses this path. Choose another one or set a domain for the site.
errors.redirectSource: Start with / and do not use spaces, ? or #.
errors.redirectTarget: Use a site path (/blog) or an address starting with https://.
errors.linkLabel: Enter a text of up to 60 characters.
errors.ctaLabel: Enter a text of up to 40 characters.
errors.phone: Check the number: include the area code.
errors.email: Enter a valid e-mail, such as hello@yourcompany.com.
errors.social: Paste the link to the {{network}} profile, starting with https://.

customers.title: Customer accounts
customers.description: Visitors create an account on the site itself to follow orders and whatever plugins offer. Accounts are separate from app users.
customers.enableHint: Shows "Sign in" at the top of the site and the account pages (sign in, sign up, password reset).
customers.required: On because an installed plugin has customer pages.
customers.empty: No customer has signed up yet.
customers.linkPeopleHint: When the customer confirms the email, the account is linked to the person with the same email. If there is none, a new contact is created for the owner below.
customers.ownerHint: Without an owner, the site only links customers to people that already exist.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: The site opens in {{language}}, the organization language. Other languages get their own address.
languages.hint: Plugins show translated content when the record has a version in that language (for example a title_en field). Without a translation, the original text appears. Account pages and theme texts come in Portuguese or English.

pathRedirects.title: Redirects
pathRedirects.description: Send visitors of an old address to a site page or to another website. Useful when replacing a website: old links keep working. A site page that answers the old address takes precedence.
pathRedirects.sourceHint: Path after the site address, starting with /.
pathRedirects.targetHint: A site path (/blog) or a full address (https://…).
pathRedirects.permanentHint: Tells search engines to replace the old address with the new one. Turn off for promotions and short-lived changes.

frame.languageHint: Pick another language to translate the texts of this section.
frame.translatingHint: Only texts show here. Leave a field empty to use the default language text; everything else applies to all languages.

header.title: Site header
header.description: What shows at the top of every page. The site name, logo and colors are in Site → Appearance (without its own name the site uses the organization name); menu links are in Site → Navigation.
header.alignHint: Follow the theme's design, put the name beside the menu or center everything. On phones the header always fits one row.
header.alignLeft: Name on the left, menu on the right
header.ctaHint: A button in the site color at the end of the menu, for example to order or book.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: What shows at the bottom of every page.
footer.textHint: {{count}} of {{max}} characters. Line breaks are kept.
footer.textPlaceholder: E.g. Handmade sweets baked every day.
footer.addressHint: Becomes a link to the map.
footer.linksEmpty: No links. Use them for pages such as Privacy policy or Careers.
footer.layoutHint: Follow the theme's design, spread the content in columns or center everything. On phones it is always one column.

frame.title: Header and footer
frame.description: What shows at the top and bottom of every page of the site, including the menu.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Identity, colors, typography and how collections look.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Which languages the site answers in.

customers.title: Site customers
customers.description: Accounts visitors create on the site itself.

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.description: Send visitors from old addresses to the right pages.

general.title: Address and cache
general.description: Where the site lives, whether search engines see it and cache clearing.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.description: Which page opens the site and what shows in the menu.

appearanceEditor.unavailable: Enable the Publication module to customize the site. Theme defaults remain available.
appearanceEditor.globalHelp: These changes apply to the entire site, including pages and collections that inherit them. Save a draft, preview it, then apply it.
appearanceEditor.frameHelp: The header and footer appear on every page of the site. Save a draft, preview it, then apply it.
appearanceEditor.saveForImages: Save the draft to select images from the shared file manager.
appearanceEditor.pending: Appearance submitted for publication. Check its approval or scheduling status before expecting it on the site.
appearanceEditor.pathHelp: Choose the public collection, an existing entry, or an empty collection by its site path.

presetDescriptions.editorial: Classic serif, cream paper, long reads.
presetDescriptions.magazine: Large lead story and a 3-column grid.
presetDescriptions.minimal: Clean list, no images, lots of space.
presetDescriptions.modern: Rounded cards with a soft shadow.
presetDescriptions.night: Dark background with an amber accent.
presetDescriptions.default: The base Aphel look, plain and readable.

appearanceEditor.presetsHelp: Applying a theme changes colors, fonts and layout. You can still adjust every option afterwards.
appearanceEditor.unsupported: This theme does not declare some saved options. Review the preview before applying, or restore defaults.
appearanceEditor.remoteChange: The saved draft changed. Your edits are preserved. Reload this page to load the latest version before saving again.
appearanceEditor.publicationFailed: Appearance was not published. Review the request in Publication, resolve its blocking reason and retry.
appearanceEditor.approvalsUnavailable: Appearance was not published. Enable Approvals to process the configured policy, then retry the publication request.
appearanceEditor.frameInvalid: Fix the highlighted header or footer fields before saving.
appearanceEditor.nameHelp: Shown in the header, footer and browser tab. When empty, the site uses the organization name.

navigation.homeDescription: What shows at the main address of the site. It can be a page, the blog or another collection.
navigation.homeDefault: Welcome screen with the site name
navigation.menuDescription: Items of the main menu, in the order they appear. An item points to a page of the site and follows its address changes; use a group to gather items in a submenu.
navigation.label: Text in the menu
navigation.urlHelp: A site path such as /contact, or an address starting with https://.
navigation.missingTarget: Page that is no longer published

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: How the site is doing and what is left to do.

identity.title: Name and logo
identity.todo: Name the site and upload the logo in Appearance.
identity.done: The site has a name and a logo.

home.title: Home page
home.todo: Choose a published page or a collection for the home page.
home.done: The home page shows published content.

menu.title: Menu
menu.todo: Add the pages visitors look for to the menu.

content.title: First published content
content.todo: Review a page or write a post and publish it.

indexing.title: Search engines
indexing.todo: The site is hidden from search engines. Allow them when it is ready.
indexing.done: Search engines can find the site.

content.title: Content
content.description: What is live and what is still a draft.

recent.title: Recently published
recent.emptyDescription: What you publish shows up here, with its link on the site.

editorKeys.scopeHelp: Shortcuts while building site pages and posts

stylesEditor.reset: Back to the theme colors and fonts
stylesEditor.contrastProblem: Low contrast in {{mode}} mode: “{{front}}” on “{{back}}”. Pick colors further apart so everyone can read.
stylesEditor.cssHelp: For people who know CSS. Applies to every page. No @import or addresses outside the site.

siteEditor.title: Site editor
siteEditor.empty: Nothing to edit yet. Install a plugin with site pages.
siteEditor.publishFailed: Could not publish. Check the request in Publication.
siteEditor.statusDefault: Plugin or theme default — any change creates your own version
siteEditor.selectHelp: Click a block in the preview or in the structure to edit it. Delete removes, Alt+↑/↓ moves, Ctrl+D duplicates, Esc selects the outer block.
siteEditor.resetDescription: Your version of this item is deleted and the site uses the plugin or theme default again.
siteEditor.deleteDescription: It leaves the site and cannot be recovered.
siteEditor.menuHelp: Use site addresses such as /contact or full https:// addresses.
siteEditor.menuUrlInvalid: Use an address such as /contact or https://…
siteEditor.saveAsPatternHelp: The selected block becomes a pattern to reuse elsewhere.
siteEditor.insertPatternHelp: Adds a copy at the end. To always use the same version, insert the “Pattern” block.
siteEditor.basePageHelp: The new template starts as a copy of the current one.
siteEditor.variantHelp: For a category or tag, use its address (for example recipes). For posts, pick the layout in the post.
siteEditor.templateCssHelp: Only applies to pages using this template.
siteEditor.exportHelp: Downloads the published design (styles, templates, parts and patterns) as a theme plugin to install on another site.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.help: Upload .woff2 (or .woff) files licensed for web use. Then pick the font for Headings or Text.
fonts.fallback: If it does not load, use
fonts.fileHelp: One file per weight and style.

list.title: Site pages
list.description: Build the pages of your site from blocks, see how they look and publish when they are ready.
list.emptyDescription: Start with "About us" or with the home page of the site.

create.title: New page
create.description: Name the page. You build its content next.
create.fieldSlugHelp: How the page shows in the browser: {{url}}

slug.invalid: Use only lowercase letters without accents, digits and hyphens. E.g. about-us
slug.reserved: This address is used by the system. Choose another one.

settings.title: Page settings
settings.description: The address changes on the site as soon as you save. The description goes live when you publish.
settings.slugPublishedHelp: Visitors with the old address are sent to the new one automatically.
settings.seoDescriptionHelp: Shown on Google and when the link is shared. Up to 300 characters.

templates.label: Start with
templates.blankHelp: Just a highlight and a text
templates.campaignHelp: Offer, benefits and a call to contact

starter.aboutHero: Say in one sentence what the company does and for whom.
starter.aboutStory: Tell how the company started, who is behind it and what changed since then.
starter.value1Text: Explain how you treat every customer.
starter.value2Text: Tell what makes your work different.
starter.value3Text: Talk about your commitment to the city and to people.
starter.servicesSubtitle: Everything we do, explained in plain words.
starter.serviceText: Describe the service and who it is for.
starter.faq1Answer: Explain the steps a customer takes to start.
starter.faq2Answer: List the payment methods you accept.
starter.contactText: Ask questions or request a quote through the channels below.
starter.campaignSubtitle: Say in one sentence what people get and until when.
starter.benefitText: Explain the advantage in a few words.
starter.campaignCall: Don't miss it: the offer ends soon.
